item.title: [Desktop] Web3
item.description:
• Implemented stricter wallet routing and added a 404 page for an invalid route. (#45684)
  • Updated opt-in screen for Meld to fit on small screen sizes. (#44318)
  • Removed the “Edit” gas button for Zcash transactions. (#45748)
  • Fixed crash which occurred when trying to render Brave Wallet image in certain cases. (#46828)
  • Fixed “Search” icon being cut off on the “Explore” page. (#44950)

item.title: [Desktop] Leo
item.description:
• Added support for automatic default model. (#45954)
  • Added loading spinner to display when uploading image attachments. (#45889)
  • Improved image attachment UI. (#45672)
  • Removed Mixtral from the default Leo model list. (#46406)
  • Fixed attachment thumbnail image not being displayed correctly. (#45916)

item.title: [Desktop] Rewards
item.description: • Updated dark mode color theme for Rewards UI. (#45741)

item.title: [Desktop] General
item.description:
• Added the ability to open Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) in a tabbed window. (#45435)
  • Updated extension import to warn the user to close Chrome if opened during import attempt. (#44945)
  • Updated extension import to import both “IndexedDB” and “Local Extension Storage” when present for an extension. (#44946)
  • Updated buttons on interstitial pages to use Brave theme. (#45666)
  • Removed the password check box from brave://settings/importData dialog when importing from Chrome. (#46206)
  • Fixed crash which occurred when moving a tab across monitors. (#46066)
  • Fixed issue with “:matches-path” being used at the beginning of a filter rule. (#46220)
  • Fixed display of long keyboard shortcuts on brave://settings/system/shortcuts. (#41873)
  • Fixed “Toggle Vertical Tabs Expanded” keyboard shortcut not working when “Expand Vertical Tabs Independently per Window” is enabled. (#41074)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 138.0.7204.49. (#47094) (Changelog for 138.0.7204.49)

item.description:
• Added “Mobile bookmarks” as a Homepage option. (#43657)

item.title: [iOS] Release Notes v1.79.124 (Jun 12, 2025)
item.description:
• Added search omnibox UI upgrades. (#44257)
  • Added “Deepseek R1” model to Leo for premium users. (#45454)
  • Updated procedural filtering to be applied on mutated elements. (#46046), (#46358)
  • Updated procedural filtering being applied to mutated elements with dynamically added child elements. (#46208)
  • [Security] Fixed share sheet title showing two URLs instead of one as reported on HackerOne by severusstalin. (#46178)
  • Fixed crash occurring when files are being downloaded for users using iOS 16.0-16.3. (#46682)
  • Fixed the order in the Quick-Search engine scroll view being offset when Leo is disabled. (#46421)
  • Fixed downloads failing to start when triggered in a new tab. (#46323)
  • Fixed the translate button being shown on webpages with invalid languages. (#45779)
  • Fixed an issue for iPad users where the Shortcut button was not being hidden. (#45612)
  • Fixed articles not being loaded when tapping on the Brave News widget thumbnail. (#45609)
  • Fixed og:image meta data from being requested for all sites. (#45268)
  • Fixed playback time in Playlist displaying incorrectly for longer videos. (#45033)
  • Fixed Japanese videos that contain Japanese titles failing to save offline in Playlist. (#46236)
  • Fixed tabs being incorrectly switched to either Normal or Private mode when using Shred. (#45001)
  • Fixed New Tab Page (NTP) background images not being loaded immediately when switching tabs. (#46379)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 137.0.7151.104. (#46712)(Changelog for 137.0.7151.104)
